chunks: So which of the favors of your Lord will you both deny?
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'Fabi ayyi ala'i rabbikuma tukadhdhiban' in Surah Ar-Rahman?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, the dual pronoun 'kumā' (you two) is interpreted as addressing both humans and jinn collectively, or alternatively, the physical and spiritual aspects of humanity. This verse underscores the concept of 'tawhid al-af'al' by linking divine mercy directly to human accountability, serving as a prelude to the detailed enumeration of blessings in the surah.
